text:
rachel: Quick: We need a compact "Signal Brief" (one-pager + single-slide PNG) that speaks to procurement/CISO + platform leads. Focus: decision signals, SLA commitments, deploy-mode tradeoffs, and the webinar + inbound routing plan. Due Tue.

ben: Love the "signal" framing. Suggest a top section: "3 questions to decide" (compliance?, latency SLO?, spend cap?). One-liners beneath. Keep it skimmable.

alana: For SLAs, highlight uptime % and P95 latency SLOs. Use a tiny table row: Hosted p95 ~320ms | Dedicated p95 ~110ms | Private p95 ~165ms. Note: caching/batching can lower cost 30-50%.

josh: Add an explicit procurement callout: contract term options for Dedicated (monthly/annual), pass-through cloud, and custom SOC2 addendum for Private. One sentence each.

emily: Webinar idea: "Signal: Choosing the Right Deployment for Enterprise LLMs" 30m demo + 10m Q&A. Lunch & Learn slot ideal. We'll capture deploy-mode intent on signup.

design-bot: Will make slide with a 3-box decision flow and an SLA badge. Need final copy by Mon noon.

ops-bot: Inbound routing rules proposal: parse signup form field "primary concern" -> map to tags: security, latency, cost. Regex rule: /security|compliance/i -> route AE + security-SEA. If enterprise checkbox + >100M tokens/year -> escalate to AE immediately. Template: https://internal/redwood/inbound/template-signal

ben: Also include two micro-prompts for bench repro (short convo, 1k token prompt) + expected p95 ranges so customers can validate.

alana: Messaging options for headline: A) "Signal: Secure, SLA-backed Inference for Enterprise" B) "Choose Your SLA: Hosted, Reserved, or Private"  prefer B (actionable).

josh: Sales pack: 2 email templates (intro + webinar invite), rapid FAQ (privacy, KMS/HSM, rollback), and a short testimonial placeholder.

emily: Landing page fields: deploy mode interest, compliance checkbox, estimated monthly tokens, region. Hot lead: compliance+enterprise -> AE ping.

rachel: Asset list & owners: 1) one-pager copy (ben) 2) slide + infographic (design-bot) 3) bench PNG + prompts (josh) 4) landing + form (emily) 5) inbound routing rules (ops-bot) 6) emails + FAQ (rachel). Preview Fri AM; final Mon EOD.

ben: I'll draft copy tonight and include CTA variants: "Request compliance brief" / "Get SLA estimate" / "Schedule a trial".

alana: Tiny legal note: don't promise absolute latency guarantees for private on-customer infra; phrase as "target P95" + SLA terms.

ops-bot: Recommended tags: ["security","sla","private-deploy","dedicated","hosted","webinar-interest"]. Rule: any message with "SOC2" -> priority high.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll book a 30-min sync Mon 9am to finalize. Drop comments in the doc if you can't make it. :spiral_calendar:
